fixes.what: Set --red to the brand book red #D10C0C and refill logo-red.svg (and the favicon) with #D10C0C; keep #9E1B32 only if the owner confirms a burgundy sub-brand, otherwise drop it. Re-check contrast of eyebrows/links on cream after the swap (#D10C0C on #F0E6D5 is ~4.3:1, fine at 16px bold).
fixes.why: Every red on the site, including the wordmark itself, is a burgundy that is not the brand red; the header logo and the painted fruit are two different reds side by side.

fixes.what: Remove the generic scribble path under the founder quote. Until a real signature SVG arrives, use the 2px red kashida rule (.rule, 120px, centred) above 'Medi, founder'.
fixes.why: A stock squiggle posing as a signature reads as costume and undercuts the 'owner's own words' premise of the quote.

fixes.what: Cap the parallax so the branch top never passes the header: BRANCH_MAX = max(0, 0.25*innerHeight - headerHeight - 16). Alternatively add a top fade to the branch mask (mask-composite with a 0-96px vertical gradient).
fixes.why: From the Inquire section down (desktop-3, journey shots) both branches slide under the fixed cream bar and look clipped by a bug, not framed.

fixes.what: On phones show one branch tip only: the left branch at 150px wide, top 60vh, opacity .8, masked to stop 24px before the gutter, pointer-events none; keep it fixed so it never sits over text columns wider than the gutter (gutter is 48px, so the tip lives in the margin and fades out).
fixes.why: At 390px the pomegranate frame vanishes for the whole scroll until the leaf band; the phone page is plain cream and loses the brand's signature device.

fixes.what: Closed strips: filter blur(2px) instead of 6px, scale 1.04; closed-panel gradient to rgba(67,38,23,.7) 0% to .15 60% to 0 100%; flex 1.4 1 0 so a strip is ~115px and a sliver of fruit reads; label 13px, letter-spacing .12em.
fixes.why: The three closed panels render as brown mud strips (desktop-2); the fruit, the whole point of the stand-ins, is invisible and the section looks dull next to the open panel.

fixes.what: Extend the 15px/letter-spacing 0 rule to max-width 1439px, set .journey__stop{overflow-wrap:normal;hyphens:manual} and let .journey__note wrap at 12px; at 1440px+ allow 16px.
fixes.why: At 1280 'Consultati / on' breaks mid-word and 'Aghd / Nikah' splits onto two lines on the hero line of the journey.
